global_rules: No scalar replaces quality, resources, latency, reliability and human effort
Ratios use cohort sums; zero accepted outcomes makes cost-per-accepted undefined
Failed, abandoned, retry, compaction, helper, verification and correction work remains included
Current target values are all null/unknown
Effects and attempt identities are distinct; parent totals are reconciled with children, not added again
